description: Canonical schema for Codi feature-definition rows and the feature hub table. Update this file first when feature-definition headers or fields change.

canonicalFields.label: Row ID
canonicalFields.description: Stable feature-definition row identifier.

canonicalFields.label: 마스터 그룹
canonicalFields.description: Source group such as original feature, shared feature, screen/state addition, or admin/operations addition.

canonicalFields.label: 레코드 유형
canonicalFields.description: Row type such as OriginalFeature, Shared, Screen, or Admin.

canonicalFields.label: 기능 종류
canonicalFields.description: Functional domain such as member/permission, product/package, tour/mission, or content/API.

canonicalFields.label: Source ID
canonicalFields.description: Source feature or source evidence identifier.

canonicalFields.label: Area
canonicalFields.description: Screen or domain area for the row.

canonicalFields.label: Title
canonicalFields.description: Human-readable feature name.

canonicalFields.label: Actor
canonicalFields.description: Primary actor such as user, admin, or system.

canonicalFields.label: Surface
canonicalFields.description: Surface such as UserApp, Admin, or System.

canonicalFields.label: Phase
canonicalFields.description: Suggested implementation phase such as P1, P2, or P3.

canonicalFields.label: Status
canonicalFields.description: Processing status such as 원본기록, 개정반영, 범위결정, or 보류.

canonicalFields.label: 결정 레벨
canonicalFields.description: Review/decision level such as 확정, 검토메모, 우선결정, or 보류검토.

canonicalFields.label: 변경 유형
canonicalFields.description: Change classification such as 원본기록, 원본분해, 수정변경, 범위조정, 병합, or 신규추가.

canonicalFields.label: 변경 대상
canonicalFields.description: Original or target feature ID connected to the change.

canonicalFields.label: 변경 요약
canonicalFields.description: Short summary of what changed from the source.

canonicalFields.label: 정의/이유
canonicalFields.description: Feature definition, reason, expected behavior, and decision background.

canonicalFields.label: 사용/연결
canonicalFields.description: Connected screens, features, policies, flows, admin pages, or APIs.

canonicalFields.label: 관리자 의존성
canonicalFields.description: Operational or admin dependency.

canonicalFields.label: 정책 의존성
canonicalFields.description: Policy dependency such as contract, permission, payment, privacy, data, or license.

canonicalFields.label: 확인 포인트
canonicalFields.description: Question or decision point that still needs review.

canonicalFields.label: Source
canonicalFields.description: Original source or enrichment evidence.

hubTableColumns.description: Operations, admin, policy, legal, data, payment, license, and open-decision checks.
